verdict.rationale: Clerk documents its own open-source tool that takes a JSON or CSV list of users and creates them in bulk through the Backend API, respecting rate limits. That is a real bulk operation, but it is scoped to basic user migration and import. missing for 10: bulk update/delete/role-assignment operations across many users or organizations, bulk actions exposed via the MCP server, CLI or dashboard, documentation of batch endpoints beyond migration, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Clerk provides an open-source tool that takes a JSON or CSV file as input, containing a list of users, and creates a user in Clerk using the Backend API... The tool respects the backend rate limits.
There are typically two main strategies for migrating your existing user management from a different platform into Clerk: Basic Export / Import, Trickle migration
